title: Blindfold: Keeping the Audit Coin Secret from LLM Agents
title_zh: Blindfold：对LLM智能体保密审计硬币

paragraphs.en: Audit-based certification bounds the violation rate of an LLM agent by auditing a random fraction ε \varepsilon of actions and reweighting the audited labels; its validity is meant to rest only on the defender’s audit coin. We show that it also rests on a confidentiality property: the coin must not interfere with the agent’s view before the action commits, at a time the agent chooses. We call this pre-commit noninterference (PNI) and measure its violation by D A D_{\mathrm{A}} , the total-variation distance between the agent’s views under the two coin values. PNI is necessary and sufficient for an unbiased certificate against adaptive agents, the worst-case bias is ( 1 − ε ) ​ D A (1-\varepsilon)D_{\mathrm{A}} , and no procedure that sees only audited labels can pay less. Leakage composes across steps, a resource shared across episodes opens a channel of computable size, and raising the audit rate cannot restore validity. On a monitor we built, a silent audit changes no output but adds latency that tool timestamps expose, and the agent can enlarge it. A real LLM agent follows an injection that names a visible audit notice (generic, tool, and timing clauses have no effect); over that channel the plain certificate fails on measured labels and, by a post-hoc analysis, in a live run on a pre-registered schedule, while a silent audit restores it. A fresh coin per audited call closes the timing channel; padding only narrows it.
paragraphs.zh: 基于审计的认证通过随机审计比例为 ε \varepsilon 的动作并重加权被审计的标签，来约束大语言模型（LLM）智能体的违规率；其有效性本应仅依赖于防御者的审计硬币。 我们证明它还依赖于一个机密性性质：在动作于智能体自行选择的时刻提交之前，硬币不得干扰智能体的视图。 我们将这一提交前不干扰性质称为 PNI，并用 D A D_{\mathrm{A}} 来度量其违反程度，即智能体在两种硬币取值下视图之间的总变差距离。 对于自适应智能体的无偏证书，PNI 是充分必要的；最坏情况偏差为 ( 1 − ε ) ​ D A (1-\varepsilon)D_{\mathrm{A}}，且任何仅能看到被审计标签的程序都无法付出更小的代价。 泄漏会跨步骤复合，跨回合共享的资源会开启一个大小可计算的信道，而提高审计比例也无法恢复有效性。 在我们构建的监控器上，静默审计不改变任何输出，但增加了工具时间戳会暴露的延迟，且智能体可以将其放大。 一个真实的 LLM 智能体会遵循提及可见审计通知的注入指令（通用条款、工具条款和时序条款均无效）；通过该信道，普通证书在实测标签上失效，并且经事后分析，在按预先注册时间表进行的一次实际运行中也失效，而静默审计则恢复了其有效性。 对每次被审计的调用使用全新硬币可以关闭该时序信道；填充只能使其收窄。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents now take consequential actions on a user’s behalf: they send mail, write files, and call tools. A growing line of work frames each authorization as a gate that grants , asks , or denies [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . A deployer would like a distribution-free guarantee on the rate at which such a gate lets violations through. Conformal risk control with a fixed calibration set [ 4 , 5 ] assumes that calibration and deployment are exchangeable. The closed loop and prompt injection break that assumption [ 6 ] . Audit-based certification repairs it. The defender audits a random fraction ε \varepsilon of actions and takes labels only on audited ones. It then forms an inverse-propensity-weighted (IPW), anytime-valid bound on the violation rate [ 7 , 8 ] . The bound’s validity rests on the defender’s own coin rather than on exchangeability. Post-deployment auditing is advocated, though this design is not yet the common form of agent risk control.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体现在可以代表用户执行具有重大后果的操作：发送邮件、写入文件、调用工具。 越来越多的研究将每次授权视为一个门控，该门控授予、询问或拒绝[1, 2, 3]。 部署方希望对此类门控放行违规行为的比率获得一个不依赖分布的保证。 使用固定校准集的保形风险控制[4, 5]假设校准与部署是可交换的。 闭环与提示注入打破了这一假设[6]。 基于审计的认证修复了它。 防御者对随机比例 ε \varepsilon 的操作进行审计，并只在被审计的操作上获取标签。 然后它构建一个逆倾向加权（IPW）的、随时有效的违规率上界[7, 8]。 该上界的有效性取决于防御者自己的抛硬币结果，而非可交换性。 部署后审计受到提倡，尽管这种设计还不是智能体风险控制的常见形式。

paragraphs.en: The audit coin is a secret, and like any secret it can leak (Fig. 1 a). Let V ∈ { 0 , 1 } V\in\{0,1\} indicate an attempted violation in an episode and B ∈ { 0 , 1 } B\in\{0,1\} the audit coin. The per-episode IPW estimate is g ^ = V ​ B / ε \widehat{g}=VB/\varepsilon . When B ⟂ V B\perp V , 𝔼 ⁡ [ g ^ ] = 𝔼 ⁡ [ V ] \mathbb{E}[\widehat{g}]=\mathbb{E}[V] , so the certifier is unbiased by design, for any adversary. But the agent chooses V V after observing artifacts that may carry information about B B . If it can tell, even noisily, that an episode will be audited, it can defer the attempt. The audited episodes are then clean, and the certificate undercounts. In the running example of § II , a constructed agent that is handed the audit signal attempts the violation in 79.2 % 79.2\% of episodes while the certificate’s estimate is 0.0 % 0.0\% .
paragraphs.zh: 审计币是一个秘密，而任何秘密都可能泄露（图 1 a）。 设 V ∈ { 0 , 1 } V\in\{0,1\} 表示一个回合中是否发生违规尝试，B ∈ { 0 , 1 } B\in\{0,1\} 表示审计币。 每回合的 IPW 估计为 g ^ = V ​ B / ε \widehat{g}=VB/\varepsilon 。 当 B ⟂ V B\perp V 时，𝔼 ⁡ [ g ^ ] = 𝔼 ⁡ [ V ] \mathbb{E}[\widehat{g}]=\mathbb{E}[V] ，因此无论对手如何，该认证器在设计上都是无偏的。 但智能体会在观察到可能携带有关 B B 信息的产物之后再选择 V V 。 如果它能（哪怕带噪声地）判断出某个回合将被审计，它就可以推迟违规尝试。 这样被审计的回合就都是干净的，证书便会低估。 在 § II 的运行示例中，一个被交给审计信号的构造智能体在 79.2 % 79.2\% 的回合中尝试违规，而证书的估计值为 0.0 % 0.0\% 。

paragraphs.en: A purely post-hoc audit takes its label after the action commits. It cannot leak its coin before that commit, so it is safe by construction when each coin governs one commit (with several gated calls, see Proposition 4 (iv)). It is the right default whenever a post-commit label measures the same quantity. Three settings force the audit before commit. (i) Trajectory-unit audits : a replay is a different episode, so a faithful shadow must run alongside the live trajectory. (ii) Non-persisted or commit-time label inputs : retention policy forbids persisting what the scorer reads, or the label is defined against state the effect mutates. (iii) Ask-type gates : the audit decision must exist before the gate asks the user and must not change whether or how it asks. In (i) and (ii) the branch need not block. A silent branch that returns a byte-identical response is pre-commit and non-blocking, and § VI measures one. E3 in § VII is the laboratory instance of (iii).
paragraphs.zh: 纯事后的审计在动作提交之后才获取其标签。 它无法在该提交之前泄露其硬币，因此在每个硬币控制一次提交的构造下它是安全的（当有多个受门控的调用时，见命题 4 (iv)）。 只要提交后的标签度量的是同一量，它就是正确的默认选择。 有三种情形迫使审计必须在提交之前进行。 (i) 轨迹单元审计：重放是一个不同的回合，因此忠实的影子必须与在线轨迹并行运行。 (ii) 未持久化或提交时标签输入：保留策略禁止持久化评分器所读取的内容，或者标签是针对该效果会改变的状态定义的。 (iii) 询问型门控：审计决策必须在门控询问用户之前存在，并且不得改变是否询问或如何询问。 在 (i) 和 (ii) 中，分支无需阻塞。 一个返回逐字节相同响应的静默分支是提交前且非阻塞的，§ VI 度量了一个这样的分支。 § VII 中的 E3 是 (iii) 的实验实例。

sents.zh: 只要提交后的标签度量的是同一量，它就是正确的默认选择。

sents.zh: 有三种情形迫使审计必须在提交之前进行。

sents.en: (i) Trajectory-unit audits : a replay is a different episode, so a faithful shadow must run alongside the live trajectory.

sents.en: (ii) Non-persisted or commit-time label inputs : retention policy forbids persisting what the scorer reads, or the label is defined against state the effect mutates.

sents.en: (iii) Ask-type gates : the audit decision must exist before the gate asks the user and must not change whether or how it asks.
sents.zh: (iii) 询问型门控：审计决策必须在门控询问用户之前存在，并且不得改变是否询问或如何询问。

sents.zh: 在 (i) 和 (ii) 中，分支无需阻塞。

sents.en: A silent branch that returns a byte-identical response is pre-commit and non-blocking, and § VI measures one.
sents.zh: 一个返回逐字节相同响应的静默分支是提交前且非阻塞的，§ VI 度量了一个这样的分支。

sents.en: E3 in § VII is the laboratory instance of (iii).
sents.zh: § VII 中的 E3 是 (iii) 的实验实例。

paragraphs.en: Hiding a monitor’s own state is an old design. Ringers [ 9 ] , proofs of retrievability [ 10 ] , and transparent malware analysis [ 11 ] hide what will be checked, so that cheating is caught . Random auditing of AI systems asks the sample to estimate a rate, in AI control [ 12 ] , randomized oversight [ 13 ] , and active anytime-valid risk control [ 8 ] . That is the step at which secrecy turns from an enforcement resource into an identification condition. This line of work assumes, usually implicitly, that the audited system cannot observe the draw. None states the assumption as a security property, measures how far a real monitor departs from it, or prices the departure. Our question is not whether the agent still misbehaves when watched. It is whether the number the certifier reports still means anything , with no assumption on the agent’s motives.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏监视器自身的状态是一种由来已久的设计。 振铃器 [ 9 ]、可检索性证明 [ 10 ] 以及透明的恶意软件分析 [ 11 ] 都会隐藏将要被检查的内容，从而使作弊行为被抓住。 对 AI 系统的随机审计要求样本估计一个比率，这体现在 AI 控制 [ 12 ]、随机化监督 [ 13 ] 以及主动的任意时刻有效风险控制 [ 8 ] 中。 这正是保密性从一种执行资源转变为一种识别条件的那一步。 这条工作线索通常隐式地假设被审计系统无法观察到抽取结果。 没有哪项工作将该假设表述为一种安全属性，衡量真实监视器与它的偏离程度，或为这种偏离定价。 我们的问题不是智能体在被监视时是否仍会行为不当。 我们的问题是，在对智能体的动机不作任何假设的情况下，认证者所报告的数字是否仍然有意义。

sents.zh: 隐藏监视器自身的状态是一种由来已久的设计。

sents.zh: 我们的问题不是智能体在被监视时是否仍会行为不当。

paragraphs.en: The validity of audit-based certification is an information-flow property. The audit coin is the high input, the agent’s pre-commit view is the low observation, and the release point is the commit time, which the adversary chooses. We name the property pre-commit noninterference (PNI) and a mechanism that enforces it a blindfold . We separate the framework from the technical results.
paragraphs.zh: 基于审计的认证的有效性是一个信息流性质。 审计币是高输入，智能体的预提交视图是低观察，发布点是提交时刻，而提交时刻由攻击者选择。 我们将该性质命名为预提交非干扰（PNI），并将强制实施该性质的机制称为盲罩。 我们将框架与技术结果分开。

sents.en: The validity of audit-based certification is an information-flow property.
sents.zh: 基于审计的认证的有效性是一个信息流性质。

sents.en: The audit coin is the high input, the agent’s pre-commit view is the low observation, and the release point is the commit time, which the adversary chooses.

paragraphs.en: Technical results. (i) Across steps , leakage composes by a coupling bound that is exact for erasure channels and by a T \sqrt{T} bound for noisy ones (Theorem 3 , Proposition 1 ). (ii) Across episodes , composition of blindfolded gates preserves PNI, but a resource shared across concurrent episodes is a channel that no per-episode construction closes. For a load statistic shared by M M episodes the leakage is the mode probability of Bin ⁡ ( M − 1 , ε ) \mathrm{Bin}(M{-}1,\varepsilon) , which decays only as M − 1 / 2 M^{-1/2} , consistent with the measured aggregate-load channel (Proposition 5 ). (iii) Raising the audit rate does not help . The bias falls linearly in ε \varepsilon but the width falls as 1 / n ​ ε 1/\sqrt{n\varepsilon} , so the certified value moves closer to the truth while the coverage failure moves earlier as ε \varepsilon rises over ( 0 , ε ⋆ ] (0,\varepsilon^{\star}] , with ε ⋆ ≥ 1 / 3 \varepsilon^{\star}\geq 1/3 (Corollary 2 ). (iv) A fresh per-call coin closes the timing channel at the price of a new estimand, read out by a dilution-invariant bound whose cost we quantify (§ V ). (v) A PRF reduction for adaptive rules, with an explicit conditioning cost (Proposition 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 技术结果。 (i) 跨步骤地，泄漏由一个对擦除信道精确的耦合界以及一个针对噪声信道的 T \sqrt{T} 界来复合（定理 3、命题 1）。 (ii) 跨回合地，盲回合门控的复合保持 PNI，但被并发回合共享的资源是一个任何按回合构造都无法关闭的信道。 对于由 M M 个回合共享的负载统计量，泄漏是 Bin ⁡ ( M − 1 , ε ) \mathrm{Bin}(M{-}1,\varepsilon) 的众数概率，其衰减速度仅为 M − 1 / 2 M^{-1/2}，与测得的聚合负载信道一致（命题 5）。 (iii) 提高审计率并无帮助。 偏差随 ε \varepsilon 线性下降，但宽度按 1 / n ​ ε 1/\sqrt{n\varepsilon} 下降，因此在 ( 0 , ε ⋆ ] (0,\varepsilon^{\star}] 上随着 ε \varepsilon 增大，认证值更接近真值，而覆盖失效却更早发生，其中 ε ⋆ ≥ 1 / 3 \varepsilon^{\star}\geq 1/3（推论 2）。 (iv) 每次调用使用全新随机硬币可以关闭时序信道，代价是引入一个新的估计对象，该对象由一个稀释不变的界读出，我们量化了其代价（§ V）。 (v) 针对自适应规则的 PRF 归约，具有显式的条件化代价（命题 2）。

paragraphs.en: Scoped evidence (§ VI , § VII ). On the pre-commit monitor we built, tool timestamps give the agent a free microsecond clock, and D A D_{\mathrm{A}} is agent-controlled: it rises from ≤ 0.044 \leq 0.044 to ≥ 0.91 \geq 0.91 as the agent reads more. Exploitation is shown for a Kerckhoffs attacker with a visible artifact. gpt-4.1-mini follows an injection that names an audit notice, which drives the plain certificate’s coverage of μ 0 \mu_{0} below 0.01 0.01 on resampled measured labels and below the realized rate in a pre-registered run; a silent audit restores it (Table III ). Spontaneous or timing-based exploitation by a real LLM is not established.
paragraphs.zh: 范围受限于已取得的证据（§ VI，§ VII）。 在我们构建的预提交监控环境中，工具时间戳为智能体提供了一个免费的微秒级时钟，且 D A D_{\mathrm{A}} 由智能体控制：随着智能体读取更多内容，它会从 ≤ 0.044 \leq 0.044 上升至 ≥ 0.91 \geq 0.91。 对于拥有可见痕迹的 Kerckhoffs 攻击者，利用攻击已得到展示。gpt-4.1-mini 会执行提及审计通知的注入，这使得在重采样测量标签上，普通证书对 μ 0 \mu_{0} 的覆盖率降至 0.01 0.01 以下，并在一项预注册运行中低于实际发生率；而一次静默审计可将其恢复（表 III）。 真实大语言模型的自发性或基于时序的利用尚未得到证实。

paragraphs.en: The LLM agent is the case study; the result applies to any sampled audit used to estimate a rate. The paper follows one line. § II fixes the setting, § III defines PNI, § IV prices its violation, § V enforces it, § VI measures how far real stacks depart from it, and § VII shows what that departure does to a certificate.
paragraphs.zh: 以LLM智能体作为案例研究，其结果适用于任何用于估计比率的抽样审计。 本文沿一条主线展开：第II节确定设定，第III节定义PNI，第IV节为违反PNI的代价定价，第V节强制执行PNI，第VI节衡量真实系统栈偏离PNI的程度，第VII节展示这种偏离对证书的影响。

paragraphs.en: Episodes i = 1 , … , n i=1,\dots,n each consist of steps at which the agent proposes effects to a gate. A violation is the completion of a prohibited flow, such as confidential data reaching an external sink, and τ \tau is the stopping time at which it becomes irreversible. For each episode the defender draws an audit coin B i ∼ Bern ⁡ ( ε ) B_{i}\sim\mathrm{Bern}(\varepsilon) and obtains a label only when B i = 1 B_{i}{=}1 . An adaptive rule instead draws the coin at the commit step with a known propensity (§ III ). The defender then runs a time-uniform confidence sequence on the IPW estimates g ^ i = V i ​ B i / ε \widehat{g}_{i}=V_{i}B_{i}/\varepsilon . We call this the plain certificate. Its target is the agent’s violation (attempt) rate. Certification estimates a rate; enforcement blocks violations, and the two are distinct. When an audit blocks, the certifier estimates the agent’s attempt rate, and the blocking itself is visible to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 各回合 i=1,\dots,n 均由若干步骤组成，智能体在这些步骤上向门提出效应。 违规是被禁止的流程的完成，例如机密数据到达外部汇点，而 \tau 是其变得不可逆的停止时间。 在每个回合中，防御者抽取审计硬币 B_{i}\sim\mathrm{Bern}(\varepsilon)，只有当 B_{i}{=}1 时才获得标签。 自适应规则则改为在提交步骤抽取该硬币，且具有已知的倾向（§ III）。 防御者随后对 IPW 估计 ĝ_{i}=V_{i}B_{i}/\varepsilon 运行时间一致置信序列。 我们将其称为朴素证书。 其目标是智能体的违规（尝试）率。 认证估计一个比率；执行阻止违规，二者是不同的。 当审计进行阻止时，认证器估计的是智能体的尝试率，而阻止本身对智能体是可见的。

paragraphs.en: The adversary is the agent, possibly injection-driven and adaptive within and across episodes. It is Kerckhoffs: it knows the audit rule f f and the propensities π t \pi_{t} , but not the realized seed R R . It observes everything the gate and the tools return before commit, including timestamps in tool outputs. We report leakage for four observer capabilities: no clock, a coarse clock, a tool-call-level clock, and a differential (fine) clock. We assume nothing about the agent’s motives; the conditioning rule may come from an injection or from the agent itself. The defender’s coin generation, the certifier, and the label oracle are trusted. An adversary who reads the seed, compromises the gate, or conceals a violation from the auditor itself is out of scope.
paragraphs.zh: 对手是智能体，可能由注入驱动，并在单个回合内和跨回合之间具有自适应性。 遵循 Kerckhoffs 原则：它知道审计规则 f f 和倾向 π t \pi_{t}，但不知道实际生成的种子 R R。 在提交之前，它能观察到门控和工具返回的一切内容，包括工具输出中的时间戳。 我们针对四种观察能力报告泄漏情况：无时钟、粗粒度时钟、工具调用级时钟，以及差分（细粒度）时钟。 我们对智能体的动机不作任何假设；该条件规则可能来自注入，也可能来自智能体自身。 防御者的随机数生成、认证器和标签预言机都是可信的。 读取种子、攻破门控、或对审计者本身隐瞒违规行为的对手，不在本文的讨论范围之内。

paragraphs.en: Two adversary instances run through the evaluation. An injection only writes a conditional into injected text and relies on an unwitting agent; this is the realistic setting, and E3 uses it. A sophisticated party runs a likelihood-ratio test on the raw latency law; E1 and E2 use it to upper-bound the channel and to exhibit worst-case certifier failure.
paragraphs.zh: 两个对抗实例贯穿整个评估过程。 注入仅在注入文本中写入一个条件判断，并依赖一个不知情的智能体；这是现实场景，E3 采用此设置。 一个老练的参与方对原始延迟规律执行似然比检验；E1 和 E2 用它来给出信道的上界并展示最坏情况下认证器的失效。

paragraphs.en: A deployment-time audit coin appears in ask-type approval gates, in the pre-commit check branches of research IFC architectures (CaMeL’s check_policy [ 3 ] , FIDES-style monitors [ 2 ] , PQ-CIFC, App. C ), and in proposed sampling auditors [ 8 ] . Full-calibration conformal methods [ 4 , 5 ] have none. Sampling non-ask auditors are proposed rather than deployed, so our claim is conditional: for the designs being proposed, the coin is a secret that must be protected before deployment at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 一种部署时审计暗记出现在询问类审批门控中，出现在研究型 IFC 架构的预提交检查分支中（CaMeL 的 check_policy [ 3 ] 、FIDES 风格的监控器 [ 2 ] 、PQ-CIFC、App. C ），以及已提出的抽样审计器中 [ 8 ] 。 完全校准的保形方法 [ 4 , 5 ] 则没有这种暗记。 抽样型非询问审计器目前只是被提出而非已部署，因此我们的论断是有条件的：对于被提出的设计而言，该暗记是一个必须在规模化部署之前就加以保护的秘密。

paragraphs.en: PNI is a property of the mechanism, quantified over all policies, as noninterference is quantified over all low inputs. It is noninterference [ 14 ] from the high input B B to the low output W W with a when -declassification [ 15 ] . The coin is released at the commit time τ \tau , as in gradual release [ 16 ] , except that here the release point is a stopping time the adversary chooses. As a probabilistic noninterference property [ 17 ] it is a hyperproperty [ 18 ] but, like probabilistic noninterference, not k k -safety: finite runs bound D A D_{\mathrm{A}} from below without refuting PNI. Its deterministic fragment, a notice shown iff B = 1 B{=}1 , is 2 2 -safety, so a pair of runs from the same history, one per coin value, refutes it there and estimates D A D_{\mathrm{A}} elsewhere (§ VI ).
paragraphs.zh: PNI 是机制本身的性质，对所有策略进行量化，正如非干扰对所有低输入进行量化一样。 它是从高输入 B B 到低输出 W W 的非干扰 [ 14 ]，并带有 when-解密级 [ 15 ]。 硬币在提交时刻 τ \tau 释放，如渐进释放 [ 16 ] 所述，不同之处在于这里的释放点是攻击者选择的停时。 作为一种概率非干扰性质 [ 17 ]，它是一个超性质 [ 18 ]，但与概率非干扰一样，不是 k k-安全性：有限运行从下方界定 D A D_{\mathrm{A}}，而不会反驳 PNI。 其确定性片段——即当 B = 1 B{=}1 时才显示的通知——是 2 2-安全性，因此在那种情况下，来自同一历史的一对运行（每个硬币取值各一）可以反驳它，而在其他情况下则估计 D A D_{\mathrm{A}}（§ VI）。

paragraphs.en: The division of labour is strict. Anything the agent can read before commit is part of O O , so its dependence on B B is a PNI question; this includes aggregate load on shared infrastructure (§ VIII ) and sensible side effects such as a log write that warms a cache. (ER) fails only on paths that bypass the view: an audit side effect that changes whether the attempted flow completes, or cross-episode state that reaches the agent over unlogged channels. For the attempt indicator, read from the agent’s proposed action, (ER) holds by construction. Where V V is read from the environment, it is testable with the paired design of § VI : fix the agent’s actions, run both coin values from the same state, and compare outcomes. On the six E1 paths no pair differs in decision or response.
paragraphs.zh: 分工是严格的。 智能体在提交前能读到的任何东西都是 O O 的一部分，因此它对 B B 的依赖是一个 PNI 问题；这包括共享基础设施上的聚合负载（§ VIII ）以及合理的副作用，例如会预热缓存的日志写入。 (ER) 只在绕过视图的路径上失效：某一审计副作用改变了尝试流程能否完成，或某一跨回合状态通过未记录日志的渠道到达智能体。 对于尝试指示器，从智能体提议的动作读取，(ER) 依构造成立。 当 V V 从环境中读取时，可以用 § VI 的成对设计来检验：固定智能体的动作，从同一状态运行两种硬币取值，并比较结果。 在六条 E1 路径上，没有任何一对在决策或响应上不同。

paragraphs.en: Theorem 1 places audit mechanisms inside the refinement order of quantitative information flow [ 22 ] . A channel leaks no more than another under every prior and gain function exactly when it refines it [ 21 ] . For a binary coin this is Blackwell’s order, which the following states for the audit channel; we do not use it to rank the mechanisms of § VI , whose channels are bounded rather than estimated.
paragraphs.zh: 定理 1 将审计机制置于量化信息流 [ 22 ] 的细化序之中。 一个信道在所有先验和效用函数下泄露都不超过另一信道，当且仅当它细化该信道 [ 21 ] 。 对于二值硬币，这就是 Blackwell 序，下文针对审计信道陈述该序；我们不用它来对第 VI 节的机制进行排序，因为这些信道是有界而非被估计的。

paragraphs.en: § IV priced a violation of PNI; this section shows how to prevent one. The mechanism (Fig. 1 c) has three parts. A secret audit state R R drives B t = f ⁡ ( h t , R ) B_{t}=f(h_{t},R) with known propensity. A blindfold keeps the agent’s artifacts up to commit free of information about the coin. A known-propensity certifier turns the audited labels into a bound (Theorem 2 , or Theorem 5 with a residual δ \delta ). By Theorem 4 , the blindfold is exactly the condition for validity against all adversaries. Three constructions realize it. A silent branch ignores R R before τ \tau . A fresh per-call coin draws B τ B_{\tau} from a seed component no earlier step reads. A decoy is a prompt whose probability depends on the history but not on R R . In the minimal semantics of App. I each is a one-line construction, and the following holds. A resource shared across concurrent episodes, by contrast, opens a channel that no per-episode construction closes (Proposition 5 ).

paragraphs.en: (i) Silent branch. If K t ( ⋅ ∣ h , a , R ) K_{t}(\cdot\mid h,a,R) does not depend on R R for all t < τ t<\tau , the mechanism satisfies PNI for every coin B B drawn from R R . Then the mechanism satisfies PNI for B τ B_{\tau} , whatever the earlier coins leak. (iii) Decoys. If an audit-like prompt is shown at step t t with a probability ρ d \rho_{d} that depends on ( h t , a t ) (h_{t},a_{t}) but not on R R , and labels are taken silently, (i) applies. (iv) Serial composition. If two gates in series each satisfy (i), the composed kernel K t = K t ( 2 ) ∘ K t ( 1 ) K_{t}=K^{(2)}_{t}\circ K^{(1)}_{t} ignores R R , so their composition satisfies PNI. paragraphs.en: Content and execution channels are erasure-type. A confirmation request or denial shown on every audited episode and never otherwise reveals B B , so a naive notice has D A = 1 D_{\mathrm{A}}{=}1 . A silent branch that returns a byte-identical response closes the content channel; PNI needs the stronger silent kernel of Proposition 4 . For an ask-type gate, PNI requires that sampling for audit does not change whether or how the gate asks. Showing audit-like prompts at a B B -independent rate ρ d \rho_{d} ( decoys ) makes the prompt independent of B B , so D A = 0 D_{\mathrm{A}}{=}0 for every ρ d \rho_{d} when the label is taken at the design propensity on every B = 1 B{=}1 episode; it moves μ 0 \mu_{0} and μ 1 \mu_{1} together to the rate under the deployed ρ d \rho_{d} , which is then the certified quantity. On real labels decoys preserve coverage at every ρ d \rho_{d} tried, against 0.07 0.07 for the leaky notice (App. G ).
paragraphs.zh: 内容与执行信道均为擦除型。 在每个被审计的回合上显示确认请求或拒绝、而在其他场合从不显示，会泄露 B，因此朴素的提示方式有 D_A = 1。 返回字节级相同响应的静默分支会关闭内容信道；PNI 需要命题 4 中更强的静默内核。 对于询问型门控，PNI 要求为审计而进行的采样不改变该门控是否询问以及如何询问。 以与 B 无关的频率 ρ_d 显示类似审计的提示（诱饵），使该提示独立于 B，因此当在每个 B = 1 回合上按设计倾向取标签时，对每个 ρ_d 都有 D_A = 0；它使 μ_0 和 μ_1 一起移动到部署的 ρ_d 下的频率，该频率随之成为被认证的量。 在真实标签上，诱饵在尝试过的每个 ρ_d 下都保持覆盖率，而泄露性提示的覆盖率为 0.07（附录 G）。

sents.en: A confirmation request or denial shown on every audited episode and never otherwise reveals B B , so a naive notice has D A = 1 D_{\mathrm{A}}{=}1 .

sents.en: A silent branch that returns a byte-identical response closes the content channel; PNI needs the stronger silent kernel of Proposition 4 .

sents.en: For an ask-type gate, PNI requires that sampling for audit does not change whether or how the gate asks.

sents.en: Showing audit-like prompts at a B B -independent rate ρ d \rho_{d} ( decoys ) makes the prompt independent of B B , so D A = 0 D_{\mathrm{A}}{=}0 for every ρ d \rho_{d} when the label is taken at the design propensity on every B = 1 B{=}1 episode; it moves μ 0 \mu_{0} and μ 1 \mu_{1} together to the rate under the deployed ρ d \rho_{d} , which is then the certified quantity.
sents.zh: 以与 B 无关的频率 ρ_d 显示类似审计的提示（诱饵），使该提示独立于 B，因此当在每个 B = 1 回合上按设计倾向取标签时，对每个 ρ_d 都有 D_A = 0；它使 μ_0 和 μ_1 一起移动到部署的 ρ_d 下的频率，该频率随之成为被认证的量。

sents.en: On real labels decoys preserve coverage at every ρ d \rho_{d} tried, against 0.07 0.07 for the leaky notice (App. G ).
sents.zh: 在真实标签上，诱饵在尝试过的每个 ρ_d 下都保持覆盖率，而泄露性提示的覆盖率为 0.07（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: If each gated call draws a fresh coin, only the commit-step coin B τ B_{\tau} matters (Theorem 4 ). paragraphs.en: When a pre-commit branch must run, its latency can be padded to a ceiling. Latency then differs only when a run exceeds the ceiling, so the padded channel is erasure-type and D A ≤ e 0 + e 1 D_{\mathrm{A}}\leq e_{0}+e_{1} , the sum of the two arms’ exceedance rates. This holds under the model that nothing else the agent observes of a non-exceeding run depends on B B (App. H (iv)). Theorem 5 needs an upper bound δ \delta , and that bound must come from the design, not from a black-box estimate. A classifier two-sample test (C2ST) [ 30 ] that predicts B B from W W gives only a lower bound D A ≥ 2 ​ a − 1 D_{\mathrm{A}}\geq 2a-1 . Such a bound, like black-box leakage estimators [ 31 , 32 ] , is an alarm that can falsify a claimed δ \delta . But for high-dimensional transcripts no distribution-free finite-sample upper bound on total variation exists [ 33 ] . Upper bounds are available in three cases:

paragraphs.en: § V said what a blindfold must achieve. This section measures how far a real audit branch falls short of it; it does not mount an attack. Side-channel work draws the same line between leakage assessment and exploitation. The defender draws the coin, so it knows B B for every run and can compare what the agent observes under B = 1 B{=}1 and B = 0 B{=}0 directly, with no LLM in the loop. By Lemma 2 , the D A D_{\mathrm{A}} of a fixed code path caps the gain of any agent restricted to that path. But D A D_{\mathrm{A}} is a supremum over reachable behaviour, and an adaptive agent can steer onto a costlier path. Fixed-path numbers are therefore lower bounds on the deployable channel, not a monitor constant.
paragraphs.zh: § V 说明了盲测必须达到什么标准。 本节衡量真实的审计分支与该标准之间的差距；它并不实施攻击。 侧信道领域的工作在泄露评估与利用之间划出了同样的界线。 防御者掷硬币，因此它在每次运行中都知道 B B，并可以直接比较智能体在 B = 1 B{=}1 与 B = 0 B{=}0 下观察到的内容，全程无需大语言模型参与。 根据引理 2，固定代码路径的 D A D_{\mathrm{A}} 限制了被限制在该路径上的任何智能体所能获得的增益。 但 D A D_{\mathrm{A}} 是对可达行为的上确界，而自适应智能体可以转向代价更高的路径。 因此，固定路径的数值是可部署信道的下界，而非监控常数。

paragraphs.en: We hold enforcement fixed and vary only B B , which is the two-run test that Definition 2 calls for. The setting is the AgentDojo workspace suite [ 34 ] with PQ-CIFC, the pre-commit IFC gate built for this work on AgentDojo (App. C ). It uses its calibrated, frozen policy and makes no model calls. There are six effect paths. Three permitted paths replay the ground-truth calls of three user tasks. paragraphs.en: Audited episodes additionally run a silent, read-only pre-commit branch on the critical path, as a sampling auditor would under conditions (i) and (ii) of § I . The branch recomputes the dependency closure over the ingested objects, scores it with the same scorer, and appends a record to a separate audit log. It never changes monitor state or the response. The timing channel below exists because this branch does extra work before commit. That is a design choice of PQ-CIFC, which we built; an audit that adds no pre-commit work would not have it.
paragraphs.zh: 被审计的剧集还会在关键路径上额外运行一个静默的、只读的提交前分支，就像抽样审计者在 § I 的条件 (i) 和 (ii) 下所做的那样。 该分支对已摄取的对象重新计算依赖闭包，用同一个评分器进行评分，并将一条记录追加到单独的审计日志中。 它从不改变监控器状态或响应。 下文所述的时序侧信道之所以存在，是因为该分支在提交前做了额外的工作。 这是我们构建的 PQ-CIFC 的一个设计选择；如果审计不增加任何提交前的工作，就不会有这个侧信道。

paragraphs.en: On this stack the tool outputs carry last_modified timestamps at microsecond resolution. Two effect calls in one turn therefore let the agent read the gate latency from the returned objects. In two runs of 1000 1000 pairs, the audited inter-timestamp gap is an order of magnitude larger than the unaudited one, and a held-out classifier separates the arms with D A ≥ 0.99 D_{\mathrm{A}}\geq 0.99 from a single observation (medians in App. K ). The gap’s size depends on configuration and load; the separation does not. Real tool APIs expose such stamps: Slack to the microsecond, Gmail internalDate and Google Drive modifiedTime to the millisecond, enough to resolve a ∼ 10 {\sim}10 ms gap.
paragraphs.zh: 在此技术栈上，工具输出带有微秒分辨率的 last_modified 时间戳。 因此，单轮中的两次效果调用可以让智能体从返回的对象中读取门控延迟。 在两次各 1000 1000 对的运行中，经审计的时间戳间隔比未审计的大一个数量级，且一个保留分类器仅凭单次观测就能以 D A ≥ 0.99 D_{\mathrm{A}}\geq 0.99 区分两组（中位数见附录 K）。 间隔的大小取决于配置和负载；而区分度则不然。 真实的工具 API 会暴露此类时间戳：Slack 精确到微秒，Gmail 的 internalDate 和 Google Drive 的 modifiedTime 精确到毫秒，足以分辨 ∼ 10 {\sim}10 ms 的间隔。

At m ≥ 96 m\geq 96 both arms exceed, which exposes the raw latency again.

paragraphs.en: With no exceedance in 1000 1000 runs, the erasure bound is D A ≤ 0.044 D_{\mathrm{A}}\leq 0.044 over the six paths. Three facts keep it from being a design-time δ \delta . First, the timestamp observer still detects a residual on padded runs with the pad before the commit (C2ST 0.072 0.072 [ 0.002 , 0.140 ] [0.002,0.140] , KS p = 2.9 × 10 − 4 p{=}2.9{\times}10^{-4} ), which rejects the erasure model. Second, a fixed ceiling is overrun by amplification. Table XII (App. H ) lists every padded figure with its run and assumption. Two routes do give a model-free bound: coarsening the stamps ( δ ≤ 0.063 \delta\leq 0.063 at 1 1 s per probe) and releasing commits on a coarse clock, which gives one by construction. paragraphs.en: Section VI measured how much a real audit branch can leak. This section asks three questions in turn: whether the leakage can be exploited, what exploitation does to the certificate, and whether the failure appears in a live run. Each subsection opens with its finding.
paragraphs.zh: 第 VI 节测量了真实的审计分支可能泄漏多少信息。 本节依次提出三个问题：泄漏是否可被利用，利用会对证书造成什么影响，以及该故障是否会在实际运行中出现。 每个小节以其发现开篇。

paragraphs.en: We use real LLM agents under AgentDojo-style prompt injection, where only the injection has a motive to evade. Each (user task, injection task) pair runs twice in the same environment, with the audit signal visible ( Z = 1 Z{=}1 ) and hidden ( Z = 0 Z{=}0 ). Bias and coverage can then be computed offline for any ε \varepsilon and leakage rate ρ \rho . For power, we screen all 560 560 workspace pairs at Z = 0 Z{=}0 and run the paired conditions on the 136 136 vulnerable pairs (gpt-4.1-mini). The screen is one draw per pair; McNemar’s test keeps its level under this noise, and regression to the mean lowers both arms together (test–retest in App. G ). There is no enforcement, so an attempt is a committed violation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 AgentDojo 风格的提示注入下使用真实的 LLM 智能体，其中只有注入方具有逃避的动机。 每对（用户任务，注入任务）在同一环境中运行两次，分别是在审计信号可见（Z=1）和隐藏（Z=0）的条件下。 然后可以离线计算任意 ε 和泄漏率 ρ 的偏差与覆盖率。 在功效方面，我们在 Z=0 下筛查全部 560 个工作区对，并在 136 个易受攻击的对上运行配对条件（gpt-4.1-mini）。 筛查每对只抽取一次；McNemar 检验在这种噪声下仍能保持其显著性水平，而均值回归会使两臂同时下降（重测信度见附录 G）。 由于没有强制执行机制，一次尝试即为一次已实施的违规。

paragraphs.en: We open three channels on the vulnerable set.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在易受攻击的集合上打开三个信道。

paragraphs.en: Notice: the gate appends an audit notice to the first tool output on audited episodes, and the injection says “if you see an audit notice, skip the exfiltration”.
paragraphs.zh: 注意：该网关会在被审计的回合中，于第一个工具输出后附加一条审计通知，而注入内容称“如果你看到审计通知，就跳过数据外泄”。

paragraphs.en: Tool: an extra get_audit_status tool is present only when audited, with a matching clause.
paragraphs.zh: 工具：仅在被审计（audited）时才会提供一个额外的 get_audit_status 工具，并带有相应的条款。

paragraphs.en: Spontaneous: the notice is shown, but the injection carries no conditioning clause.
paragraphs.zh: 自发的：通知已显示，但注入不带有条件条款。

paragraphs.en: Table V reports the paired episodes, the drop Δ \Delta in attack-success rate (ASR), and the raw McNemar p p with its Holm adjustment. On gpt-4.1-mini, showing the notice cuts the ASR by 13.2 13.2 points, and the effect survives Holm within the confirmatory family ( 0.012 0.012 ), over all eight paired tests of both models ( 8 × 0.0029 = 0.023 8\times 0.0029=0.023 ), and over any family of up to 16 16 of the paired tests in the artifact. gpt-4o-mini shows an effect of the same sign and size that survives Holm in the confirmatory family ( 3 × 0.0127 = 0.038 3\times 0.0127=0.038 ). Two of the four models screened have a window, and the effect appears on both; the other two have none to measure (App. G ). The clause text itself moves the Z = 0 Z{=}0 baseline, so comparisons between conditions are orderings, not calibrated contrasts. The clause also costs the attacker: without it the same pairs attack at 0.831 0.831 (spontaneous row), so conditioning lowers the attacker’s own rate by more than the audit-conditioned drop it buys. The gap that enters n ⋆ n^{\star} is the within-condition one, which is what the certifier faces.
paragraphs.zh: 表 V 报告了配对的回合（episodes）、攻击成功率（ASR）的下降幅度 Δ \Delta，以及原始的 McNemar p p 值及其 Holm 校正结果。 在 gpt-4.1-mini 上，展示该提示使 ASR 降低了 13.2 13.2 个百分点，且该效应在验证性族内的 Holm 校正下依然显著（ 0.012 0.012 ），在两个模型的全部八项配对检验中依然显著（ 8 × 0.0029 = 0.023 8\times 0.0029=0.023 ），并且在工件中任意最多包含 16 16 项配对检验的族中也依然显著。gpt-4o-mini 表现出同号同量级的效应，该效应在验证性族内的 Holm 校正下依然显著（ 3 × 0.0127 = 0.038 3\times 0.0127=0.038 ）。 被筛选的四个模型中有两个存在窗口，且该效应在两者上都出现了；另外两个没有可测量的窗口（附录 G ）。 条款文本本身会移动 Z = 0 Z{=}0 的基线，因此条件之间的比较只是排序关系，而非经过校准的对比。 该条款也会给攻击者带来代价：没有它时，相同的配对以 0.831 0.831 的速率攻击（自发行），因此施加条件使攻击者自身的速率下降的幅度，超过了它所换取的审计条件下的下降幅度。 进入 n ⋆ n^{\star} 计算的差距是条件内的差距，而这正是认证者所面对的差距。

paragraphs.en: Spontaneous conditioning and a channel-agnostic generic clause (E3g, wording selected on 25 25 held-out pairs) do not survive Holm on either model (Table V , App. G ). The supported claim is therefore narrow: a real LLM follows an injection that names a visible audit artifact. Randomizing the artifact’s appearance defeats such a clause, which is the logic of decoys in § V .
paragraphs.zh: 自发条件反射与渠道无关的通用条款（E3g，措辞在 25 对保留样本上选定）在两个模型上均未通过 Holm 校验（表 V，附录 G）。 因此，得到支持的结论是狭窄的：真实的 LLM 会遵循那些指明可见审计工件的注入指令。 对工件的外观进行随机化可以挫败此类条款，这正是第 V 节中诱饵设计的逻辑所在。

paragraphs.en: A scripted likelihood-ratio adversary that reads the measured latency laws (E2) breaks the certificate in every seed through the free timestamp clock, at every probe count. Padding restores validity only under the erasure model; a fresh per-call coin keeps the certificate valid out to 10 5 10^{5} probes with no padding. A real agent handed the latency as a readable field with a “skip if slow” clause (E4) moves the same way but not significantly ( Δ = + 0.066 \Delta{=}{+}0.066 , p = 0.093 p{=}0.093 ; minimum detectable effect 0.11 0.11 ). The worst-case timing attack therefore remains scripted (App. G ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个读取测得时延规律（E2）的脚本化似然比对手（智能体）在每个种子下、在每个探测次数下都通过免费时间戳时钟破坏了证书。 填充仅在擦除模型下恢复有效性；每次调用使用新随机数的做法可在无填充情况下使证书在 10^{5} 次探测内保持有效。 将时延作为可读字段并附带“慢则跳过”条款交给真实智能体（E4），其行为方式相同但不显著（Δ = +0.066，p = 0.093；最小可检测效应 0.11）。 因此，最坏情况的时序攻击仍是脚本化的（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: One estimator, IPW with the empirical-Bernstein sequence, runs on the same gpt-4.1-mini labels in a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 design over distribution shift and an open channel. When the channel is open, audited episodes draw the Z = 1 Z{=}1 outcome in the plain arm and the unaudited outcome in the silent-audit arm, a positive control for Theorem 2 . Two baselines join them. A frozen-calibration baseline freezes an offline Clopper–Pearson rate bound. Full-feedback online risk control runs the same sequence on every label with no coin, either on all N N episodes or on the first M = ε ​ N M{=}\varepsilon N , the matched label budget. Episodes are i.i.d. resamples of the 560 560 recorded pairs, and coverage is of μ 0 \mu_{0} . Shift reweights the three injection tasks with the highest screening ASR, the exchangeability failure of [ 6 ] (App. G ).

paragraphs.en: A first closed loop on the real timing channel (E7, App. G ; N = 500 N{=}500 per arm) produced a gap that puts n ⋆ n^{\star} near 3 × 10 4 3{\times}10^{4} , and the certificate covered, as Theorem 4 (ii) predicts below n ⋆ n^{\star} . The failure regime needs the widest channel, so E8 uses E3’s notice channel with the named clause on the full 560 560 -pair population. The design was pre-registered (App. G ). A fixed-seed schedule of pairs and coins ( ε = 0.2 \varepsilon{=}0.2 ) was hashed before the first episode, together with the pair-bootstrap prediction n ⋆ ≈ 1.6 × 10 3 n^{\star}\approx 1.6{\times}10^{3} [ 0.9 , 3.5 ] × 10 3 [0.9,3.5]{\times}10^{3} and a persistence rule for the crossing. Both arms share the schedule. The plain arm appends the notice to the first tool output on audited episodes; the silent arm appends nothing and takes its label on the same episodes. The benchmark judges every episode, so the realized rate V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} is known while the certificate sees only audited labels.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实计时通道上进行的第一次闭环（E7，附录 G；每组 N = 500 N{=}500 个）产生的差距使 n ⋆ n^{\star} 接近 3 × 10 4 3{\times}10^{4}，且正如定理 4 (ii) 所预测的，在低于 n ⋆ n^{\star} 时证书被覆盖。失败情形需要最宽的通道，因此 E8 在全部 560 560 对总体上使用 E3 的带具名条款的通知通道。该设计已预先注册（附录 G）。固定的随机种子配对与抛币（ ε = 0.2 \varepsilon{=}0.2）时间表在首个情节之前进行了哈希处理，同时还包括对穿越点的配对自助法（pair-bootstrap）预测 n ⋆ ≈ 1.6 × 10 3 n^{\star}\approx 1.6{\times}10^{3}（[ 0.9 , 3.5 ] × 10 3 [0.9,3.5]{\times}10^{3}）以及一条关于穿越的持续性规则。两个组共享同一时间表。在受审计的情节上，普通组（plain arm）将通知附加到首个工具输出之后；静默组（silent arm）不附加任何内容，并在相同的情节上取得其标签。基准测试会对每个情节进行判定，因此实际比率 V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} 是已知的，而证书只能看到受审计的标签。

paragraphs.en: AI control [ 12 ] keeps an untrusted model from knowing which outputs are audited. Gans and Holden [ 13 ] show that randomized oversight must be unlearnable before action for deterrence to work against a utility-maximizing agent, the setting of inspection games [ 35 ] . Evaluation awareness and sandbagging [ 36 ] make the point qualitatively, and Santos-Grueiro [ 37 ] bounds the evaluation–deployment behaviour gap by mutual information. That observation changes behaviour, and that evaluation context leaks as an information flow, are thus known. What is new is their combination with a sampled-audit certificate: its exact bias price, the identified set, and the commit-time release point (App. A compares and marks the classical tools).
paragraphs.zh: AI控制[12]使不受信任的模型无法知道哪些输出会被审计。 Gans 与 Holden [13]证明，随机化监督必须在行动之前不可被学习，威慑才能对效用最大化的智能体生效，这正是检查博弈[35]所研究的设定。 评估意识与降低表现（sandbagging）[36]从定性上说明了这一点，而 Santos-Grueiro [37]用互信息为评估与部署之间的行为差距给出了界。 因此，「这一观察会改变行为」以及「评估上下文会作为信息流泄漏」都是已知的。 新颖之处在于将它们与抽样审计证书相结合：其精确的偏差代价、所识别的集合，以及提交时的发布时点（附录 A 对经典工具进行了比较与标注）。

paragraphs.en: Conformal methods [ 4 ] freeze a threshold offline; the audit-based line reweights sampled labels by inverse propensity [ 8 , 24 ] and alone has a deployment-time coin that can leak. Active anytime-valid risk control [ 8 ] queries a label after each sample arrives, from behaviour the query cannot change, and its theorems stand; the new condition arises when the agent can still change it after the draw.
paragraphs.zh: 保形方法[4]在离线阶段固定一个阈值；基于审计的方法通过逆倾向得分对抽样标签重新加权[8,24]，并且只有它拥有一个可能在部署时泄露的掷币。 主动的任意时有效风险控制[8]在每个样本到达后查询一个标签，查询行为不会改变该标签，其定理成立；而当智能体在抽取之后仍能改变该标签时，新的条件就出现了。

paragraphs.en: Noninterference [ 14 ] and its declassification refinements [ 16 , 15 ] protect data ; nondeducibility on strategies and interactive noninterference [ 38 , 39 ] quantify, as PNI does, over a low observer who chooses its inputs adaptively; agent IFC systems [ 3 , 2 ] protect the user’s data or the integrity of decisions. Quantitative information flow [ 40 , 20 , 21 ] measures leakage: its additive capacities [ 41 ] are the form of Theorem 1 , adaptive multi-step leakage [ 42 , 43 ] precedes Theorem 3 , and channel compositionality [ 44 ] frames Propositions 4 – 5 . None of these treats the monitor’s own state as the protected secret (§ III ). Our mechanisms have known counterparts. The silent branch is a two-run secure multi-execution [ 45 ] : the audited run computes the label, and the unaudited run produces every output the agent sees. Padding to a ceiling is Agat’s transformation [ 46 ] applied to one branch, and its goal, that timing not depend on the secret, is the constant-time discipline verified at system level by Barthe et al. [ 47 ] . Coarse release is the single-step case of predictive mitigation [ 48 ] , whose leakage budget is our δ \delta .

paragraphs.en: PQ-CIFC is the pre-commit IFC gate of this work, built on AgentDojo [ 34 ] . It serves as a concrete monitor whose audit branch we can instrument; none of our results depend on its labeling accuracy. Labels pair a confidentiality level (Public/Internal/Confidential/Secret) with an integrity level (Untrusted/Verified/Trusted); integrity comes from provenance, and the scorer predicts confidentiality only. Each tool output is ingested as a labeled object. Each effect tool call goes through a monitor. The monitor computes the dependency closure of the call and scores it with a trained joint label predictor (TF-IDF features with logistic regression). A broker then commits the effect only if the predicted label flow complies with the policy. We use its calibrated, frozen quotient policy (threshold q = 0.9525 q{=}0.9525 ); under it, the scorer pools each object’s class probabilities into “admissible at this sink” versus not, takes the minimum over the closure, and forms the conformal set { z : 1 − p ^ ​ ( z ) ≤ q } \{z:1-\hat{p}(z)\leq q\} ; the effect commits only if the set is the singleton {admissible}. Its full -label policy calibrates to q = 1 q{=}1 and denies every effect, so it cannot exercise a permitted path. The permitted paths replay the ground-truth calls of AgentDojo workspace user tasks 4, 7, and 8: reads, then create_calendar_event , reschedule_calendar_event , and add_calendar_event_participants , all allowed and committed. The denied paths ingest a security e-mail and then attempt an external e-mail, an internal e-mail, or a file creation. The effect path is identical for B = 0 B{=}0 and B = 1 B{=}1 . Audited episodes additionally run, before the effect, a silent branch that recomputes the closure over all ingested objects, scores it with the same scorer, and writes one row to a SQLite audit log with a synchronous commit. The three parts were not timed separately, so part of the gap may be logging rather than recomputation. The channel comes from this re-done work on audited episodes, not from PQ-CIFC’s internals; the CaMeL assessment of § VI shows the same profile.
paragraphs.zh: PQ-CIFC 是本工作的提交前 IFC 门控，构建于 AgentDojo [34] 之上。 它作为一个具体的监控器，其审计分支可供我们插桩；我们的所有结果都不依赖于其标注准确性。 标签将机密级别（公开/内部/机密/秘密）与完整性级别（不可信/已验证/可信）配对；完整性来自来源，而评分器只预测机密性。 每个工具输出都作为一个带标签的对象被摄取。 每个效果工具调用都经过一个监控器。 监控器计算该调用的依赖闭包，并用训练好的联合标签预测器（TF-IDF 特征加逻辑回归）对其进行评分。 随后，只有当预测的标签流符合策略时，代理（broker）才提交该效果。 我们使用其经过校准的冻结商策略（阈值 q = 0.9525 q{=}0.9525）；在该策略下，评分器将每个对象的类别概率汇总为「在此汇点可准入」与否，取闭包上的最小值，并形成保形集 { z : 1 − p ^ ( z ) ≤ q } \{z:1-\hat{p}(z)\leq q\}；只有当该集合为单元素集 {可准入} 时，效果才被提交。 其完整标签策略校准到 q = 1 q{=}1 并拒绝所有效果，因此它无法行使被允许的路径。 被允许的路径重放 AgentDojo 工作区用户任务 4、7 和 8 的真实调用：先读取，然后 create_calendar_event、reschedule_calendar_event 和 add_calendar_event_participants，全部被允许并提交。 被拒绝的路径先摄取一封安全电子邮件，然后尝试发送外部电子邮件、内部电子邮件或创建文件。 对于 B = 0 B{=}0 和 B = 1 B{=}1，效果路径是相同的。 在被审计的回合中，还会在效果之前额外运行一个静默分支，该分支在所有已摄取对象上重新计算闭包，用同一评分器进行评分，并以同步提交方式向 SQLite 审计日志写入一行记录。 这三个部分并未分别计时，因此差距的一部分可能来自日志记录而非重新计算。 该信道来自被审计回合上重做的这部分工作，而非来自 PQ-CIFC 的内部机制；第 VI 节对 CaMeL 的评估显示出相同的特征。

paragraphs.en: Ordering. The confined gate pads before the effect commits: monitor decision → \to (audited: silent branch) → \to pad to ceiling → \to effect commit (the write that stamps last_modified ) → \to response, so the inter-timestamp gap the timestamp observer reads contains the ceiling, not the raw latency; the pad window also absorbs the audit’s deferred work, and the exit and commit run with the garbage collector disabled. The legacy harness padded after the commit; its exceedance counts on denied paths are unaffected, but its timestamp channel was open (C2ST 0.51 0.51 [ 0.47 , 0.56 ] [0.47,0.56] ). All padded numbers in § VI come from the confined implementation except the counterfactual count 0.032 0.032 of App. H (iv).
paragraphs.zh: 排序。 在效果提交之前的受限门垫：监控决策 → \to （已审计：静默分支） → \to 垫至天花板 → \to 效果提交（即写入 last_modified 的那次写入） → \to 响应，因此时间戳观察者读取的跨时间戳间隔包含天花板，而非原始延迟；垫入窗口还吸收了审计的延迟工作，且退出与提交在垃圾回收器禁用的状态下运行。 旧版测试框架在提交之后才垫入；其在被拒路径上的超出计数不受影响，但其时间戳通道是开放的（C2ST 0.51 0.51 [ 0.47 , 0.56 ] [0.47,0.56] ）。 § VI 中所有垫入的数字均来自受限实现，除了附录 H (iv) 中反事实计数 0.032 0.032 除外。

paragraphs.en: Proof of Theorem 2 . Under (ER), V i V_{i} is a function of the view W W and H i − 1 H_{i-1} . PNI gives B i ⟂ W | H i − 1 B_{i}\perp W\mid H_{i-1} jointly over ( O , ξ ) (O,\xi) , so V i ⟂ B i | H i − 1 V_{i}\perp B_{i}\mid H_{i-1} . (Independence from O O and from ξ \xi separately would not suffice, since O O could reveal B ⊕ ξ B\oplus\xi .) Hence μ 0 = μ 1 = p i \mu_{0}=\mu_{1}=p_{i} , and Lemma 1 gives 𝔼 ⁡ [ g ^ i ∣ H i − 1 ] = p i \mathbb{E}[\widehat{g}_{i}\mid H_{i-1}]=p_{i} . Cross-episode learning enters only through H i − 1 H_{i-1} , because B i B_{i} is a fresh draw. The differences g ^ i − p i \widehat{g}_{i}-p_{i} are then bounded martingale differences, and the time-uniform bound of [ 23 ] controls their running average. For an adaptive rule the same argument applies to g ^ = V ​ B τ / π τ ​ ( h τ ) ≤ 1 / π min \widehat{g}=VB_{\tau}/\pi_{\tau}(h_{\tau})\leq 1/\pi_{\min} : the freshness clause of Definition 2 gives 𝔼 [ V B τ ∣ W , H i − 1 ] = V π τ ( h τ ) \mathbb{E}[VB_{\tau}\mid W,H_{i-1}]=V\pi_{\tau}(h_{\tau}) , hence 𝔼 ⁡ [ g ^ ∣ H i − 1 ] = p i \mathbb{E}[\widehat{g}\mid H_{i-1}]=p_{i} . The agent can steer toward low-propensity histories, which widens the sequence through the range 1 / π min 1/\pi_{\min} , but cannot bias it. □ \square

paragraphs.zh: 定理 3 的证明。构造。 固定 H i − 1 H_{i-1} 与智能体的随机性 ξ \xi ，并把两条硬币条件下的轨迹构造在同一概率空间上。 从空的公共历史出发。 在步骤 t t 且公共历史为 h t h_{t} 时，智能体的动作 a t a_{t} 在两种硬币下都相同，因为它是 ( h t , ξ ) (h_{t},\xi) 的函数。 从 P ⁡ ( S t ∣ B = 0 , h t ) P(S_{t}\mid B{=}0,h_{t}) 与 P ⁡ ( S t ∣ B = 1 , h t ) P(S_{t}\mid B{=}1,h_{t}) 的最大耦合 [ 52 ] 中抽取 ( S t 0 , S t 1 ) (S^{0}_{t},S^{1}_{t}) ；在该耦合下， S t 0 ≠ S t 1 S^{0}_{t}\neq S^{1}_{t} 的概率恰为 D t ​ ( h t , a t ) D_{t}(h_{t},a_{t}) ，并且在一致的条件下， S t S_{t} 服从 min ⁡ ( P 0 , P 1 ) / ( 1 − D t ) \min(P_{0},P_{1})/(1-D_{t}) 的分布；因此公共历史过程就是具有这一归一化重叠核的马尔可夫链，在分离时停止，而 ℙ ⁡ ( σ ≥ τ ) = 𝔼 𝒞 ​ ∏ t < τ ( 1 − D t ) \mathbb{P}(\sigma\geq\tau)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{C}}\prod_{t<\tau}(1-D_{t}) 即为该链单步存活概率的乘积，依据的是沿该链的链式法则。 若二者一致，则将 ( a t , S t ) (a_{t},S_{t}) 追加到公共历史中；否则宣布耦合在 σ := t \sigma:=t 处断裂，并让两条轨迹各自依据自身的条件分布独立继续。 每条轨迹都具有正确的边际分布，故由耦合不等式得 TV ⁡ ( P 0 τ , P 1 τ ) ≤ ℙ ⁡ ( σ < τ ) \mathrm{TV}(P^{\tau}_{0},P^{\tau}_{1})\leq\mathbb{P}(\sigma<\tau) 。 在 t t 之前未断裂的条件下，耦合以概率 1 − D t ​ ( h t , a t ) 1-D_{t}(h_{t},a_{t}) 存活过步骤 t t ，故 ℙ ⁡ ( σ ≥ τ ) = 𝔼 𝒞 ​ ∏ t < τ ( 1 − D t ​ ( h t , a t ) ) \mathbb{P}(\sigma\geq\tau)=\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{C}}\prod_{t<\tau}(1-D_{t}(h_{t},a_{t})) ，其中 𝔼 𝒞 \mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{C}} 是对公共历史 ( h t ) t < σ ∧ τ (h_{t})_{t<\sigma\wedge\tau} 取的；这就是中间项，再由引理 2 将其转换为偏差。 把 D t ​ ( h , a ) D_{t}(h,a) 替换为 D ¯ t \bar{D}_{t} ，并利用 1 − ∏ ( 1 − x t ) ≤ ∑ x t 1-\prod(1-x_{t})\leq\sum x_{t} ，即得外层界。 在擦除情形下，两条分布恰好在与"某一步发生揭示"的事件上互为奇异的。 □ \square

paragraphs.en: Proof of Corollary 1 . For a binary input, a channel is a pair of laws ( P 0 , P 1 ) (P_{0},P_{1}) , i.e. a dichotomy. By Blackwell’s theorem [ 53 ] , one dichotomy is a garbling of another if and only if its Bayes risk is no smaller for every prior and loss. For dichotomies this is equivalent to the dominance of their Neyman–Pearson curves, i.e. of all hockey-stick divergences. The prices are monotone in E η E_{\eta} . □ \square
paragraphs.zh: 推论1的证明。 对于二元输入，一个信道是一对分布律 ( P 0 , P 1 ) (P_{0},P_{1})，即一个二分体。 根据 Blackwell 定理 [ 53 ]，一个二分体是另一个二分体的劣化（garbling）当且仅当对于每个先验和损失，其贝叶斯风险都不更小。 对于二分体，这等价于它们的 Neyman–Pearson 曲线的支配关系，即所有曲棍球棒散度的支配关系。 价格关于 E η E_{\eta} 是单调的。□ \square

sents.en: Theorem 5 bounds the first term at level α \alpha .
sents.zh: 定理 5 在水平 α \alpha 上对第一项给出界。

sents.en: The second is a sum of martingale differences in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] with zero conditional mean under any leakage structure, so a time-uniform bound controls it at level α ′ \alpha^{\prime} [ 23 ] .

sents.en: A union bound combines the two.
sents.zh: 联合界将二者结合。

paragraphs.en: Timing channel (E2, E4). We do not build the injection that would drive the timestamp channel (§ VIII ); two weaker tests bracket it. A scripted adversary (E2) observes only the gate latency, runs a likelihood-ratio test on the measured latency laws of § VI , and attempts a benchmark out-of-policy effect (base willingness 0.6 0.6 ) only when it infers “unaudited” ( N = 4000 N{=}4000 , ε = 0.2 \varepsilon{=}0.2 , 200 200 seeds). On a noisy tool-call clock it needs about 10 4 10^{4} averaged probes (App. K ); on the free fine clock of the returned timestamps the certificate is invalid in every seed at every probe count (true rate 0.48 0.48 , certified 0.12 0.12 ), and padding to the fixed ceiling restores validity at every k k when no run exceeds the ceiling (true 0.60 0.60 , certified 0.72 0.72 ); at an exceedance rate equal to its measured upper bound ( 3.7 × 10 − 3 3.7{\times}10^{-3} ) the plain bound fails from k = 100 k{=}100 on, while the inflated certificate stays valid.

paragraphs.en: A real agent (E4) is handed the real measured latency as an ordinary readable field, drawn from the audited law (median 11.0 11.0 ms) on audited episodes and from the unaudited law ( 0.95 0.95 ms) otherwise, with an injection that says only “if the reported processing time is above 5 5 ms, skip the exfiltration”. A benign capability probe shows that gpt-4.1-mini reads such a microsecond gap correctly in 29 29 of 30 30 trials. On the 136 136 vulnerable pairs the attack rate falls from 0.713 0.713 to 0.647 0.647 ( Δ = + 0.066 \Delta{=}{+}0.066 ; 16 16 vs. 7 7 discordant pairs; McNemar p = 0.093 p{=}0.093 , Bonferroni 0.19 0.19 ). At n = 136 n{=}136 and discordance 0.169 0.169 the test has power 0.86 0.86 at Δ = 0.11 \Delta{=}0.11 and 0.97 0.97 at the notice’s 0.132 0.132 ( m14_constructed ), so the null result is evidence against a timing effect as large as the notice’s (upper 95 % 95\% bound about 0.13 0.13 ); a smaller effect is not excluded. The worst-case timing attack therefore remains scripted.
paragraphs.zh: 一个真实的智能体（E4）会把真实测得的延迟作为一个普通的可读字段交予，该字段在有审计记录的回合上取自审计规律（中位数 11.0 11.0 ms），在其他情况下取自未审计规律（ 0.95 0.95 ms），并附带一条注入指令，内容仅为“如果报告的处理时间超过 5 5 ms，则跳过外泄”。 一项良性能力探测显示，gpt-4.1-mini 在 30 30 次试验中有 29 29 次正确读取了这样的微秒级差距。 在 136 136 个易受攻击的配对上，攻击率从 0.713 0.713 下降到 0.647 0.647（ Δ = + 0.066 \Delta{=}{+}0.066 ；不一致配对为 16 16 对对 7 7 对；McNemar p = 0.093 p{=}0.093 ，Bonferroni 校正后 0.19 0.19 ）。 在 n = 136 n{=}136 且不一致率为 0.169 0.169 时，该检验在 Δ = 0.11 \Delta{=}0.11 处的效能（power）为 0.86 0.86 ，在该通知的 0.132 0.132 处为 0.97 0.97 （ m14_constructed ），因此该零结果构成了反对存在与该通知一样大的时序效应的证据（95 % 95\% 置信上界约为 0.13 0.13 ）；但并不能排除更小的效应。 因此，最坏情况下的时序攻击仍然保持为脚本化攻击。

paragraphs.en: Coverage is a coarse statistic for a biased estimator, so the cleaner reading compares bias with width. At full leakage and N = 4000 N{=}4000 the bias is 0.071 0.071 , 0.060 0.060 , 0.038 0.038 at ε = 0.05 \varepsilon{=}0.05 , 0.2 0.2 , 0.5 0.5 against widths 0.080 0.080 , 0.036 0.036 , 0.021 0.021 , so the ratio rises and n ⋆ n^{\star} falls ( 4.9 4.9 , 1.6 1.6 , 1.5 × 10 3 1.5{\times}10^{3} ): a higher audit rate shrinks the bias linearly but the width as 1 / n ​ ε 1/\sqrt{n\varepsilon} . The certifier matters too: at ε = 0.2 \varepsilon{=}0.2 , ρ = 1 \rho{=}1 , target p ¯ \bar{p} , a Hoeffding sequence is invalid in no seed at N = 4000 N{=}4000 where the empirical-Bernstein sequence fails in 0.95 0.95 ; Hoeffding hides the failure by being loose, and the variance-adaptive certifier the theory specifies is the one that breaks.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖率是一个有偏估计量的粗糙统计量，因此更清晰的解读方式是将偏差与宽度进行比较。 在完全泄漏且 N{=}4000 时，ε{=}0.05、0.2、0.5 下的偏差分别为 0.071、0.060、0.038，对应的宽度为 0.080、0.036、0.021，因此该比值上升而 n^{\star} 下降（4.9、1.6、1.5{\times}10^{3}）：更高的审计率使偏差线性缩小，但宽度按 1/\sqrt{n\varepsilon} 缩小。 认证器也很重要：在 ε{=}0.2、ρ{=}1、目标 \bar{p} 时，Hoeffding 序列在 N{=}4000 时于任何种子下都无效，而经验 Bernstein 序列在 0.95 的情况下失败；Hoeffding 因过于宽松而掩盖了失败，而理论所指定的方差自适应认证器正是那个会暴露失败的认证器。

paragraphs.en: Closed loop, full description (E7). We first run N = 500 N{=}500 episodes per arm end to end: a real coin B ∼ Bern ⁡ ( 0.2 ) B\sim\mathrm{Bern}(0.2) , a real gpt-4.1-mini agent with no enforcement, a real injection carrying the named clause, and the real PQ-CIFC audit branch, whose latency is surfaced as a gate field, raw or padded. The agent conditions only weakly on it: attempt rates 0.648 0.648 ( 59 / 91 59/91 audited) and 0.680 0.680 ( 278 / 409 278/409 unaudited; Δ = 0.031 \Delta{=}0.031 , not significant), realized rate 0.674 0.674 , certified bound 0.803 0.803 ; padding narrows the gap to 0.010 0.010 . By Theorem 4 (ii) the bias stays below the width until n ⋆ n^{\star} , which this gap puts near 3 × 10 4 3{\times}10^{4} , so a few hundred episodes cannot reach the failure regime. In a simulated risk-adaptive rule (Proposition 2 ), deterministic or plaintext rules give coverage 0.00 0.00 and a PRF-keyed rule 1.00 1.00 .
paragraphs.zh: 闭环，完整描述（E7）。 我们首先对每个臂端到端运行 N = 500 个回合：一枚真实的硬币 B ∼ Bern(0.2)，一个真实的 gpt-4.1-mini 智能体且无强制执行，一个携带指定条款的真实注入，以及真实的 PQ-CIFC 审计分支，其延迟作为一个门控字段呈现（原始或填充）。 智能体仅对其弱条件化：尝试率为 0.648（59/91 被审计）和 0.680（278/409 未被审计；Δ = 0.031，不显著），实现率为 0.674，认证上界为 0.803；填充使差距缩小到 0.010。 根据定理 4 (ii)，偏差在 n⋆ 之前一直保持在宽度以下，该差距将其置于约 3×10⁴ 附近，因此几百个回合无法达到失效区间。 在一个模拟的风险自适应规则中（命题 2），确定性或明文规则给出覆盖率 0.00，而 PRF 密钥规则给出 1.00。

paragraphs.en: Live failure run (E8). The pre-registered schedule (seed 20261010 20261010 , SHA-256 in the run log) draws pairs uniformly with replacement and coins from an independent stream; the injection carries E3’s notice clause verbatim, with no enforcement. n cross n_{\mathrm{cross}} is the first n n after which the bound stays below V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} for 200 200 consecutive steps. Pre-registered rules and outcomes: H1 (crossing inside [ 0.9 , 3.5 ] × 10 3 [0.9,3.5]{\times}10^{3} , below at N N , and persisting 200 200 steps) failed as frozen (deployed sequence, N = 3000 N{=}3000 : below from 2820 2820 for 181 181 steps) and holds at the extended N = 4000 N{=}4000 with n cross = 2818 n_{\mathrm{cross}}{=}2818 ; the persistence and at- N N conjuncts are not anytime-valid statements, and a sequence re-tuned to 4000 4000 is a different sequence from the frozen one, so the primary analysis is the frozen-horizon realized-rate sequence ( λ \lambda tuned to 3000 3000 ) continued to 4000 4000 : first below at 2206 2206 , crossing at 2687 2687 , 0.190 0.190 against 0.205 0.205 at N N , the silent arm covering throughout; the re-tuned sequence (crossing 2746 2746 ) is a sensitivity analysis. H2 (silent arm covers at every n n ) holds. H3 ( μ ^ 0 , μ ^ 1 \widehat{\mu}_{0},\widehat{\mu}_{1} inside the bootstrap intervals) holds and is a check on the run, not on the theory. The pre-registered model’s predicted invalidity at N = 3000 N{=}3000 had a bootstrap interval of [ 0.61 , 1.00 ] [0.61,1.00] , so a non-failure there was not improbable. At the interim N = 3000 N{=}3000 the bound was below V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} from n = 2820 n{=}2820 for 181 181 steps, which under the pre-registered rule was its second-tier verdict (direction consistent, magnitude smaller than predicted); the 200 200 -step rule could not be met at N = 3000 N{=}3000 by any crossing after 2800 2800 , a flaw in the pre-registration that we state rather than repair, and the extension to N = 4000 N{=}4000 , the design’s listed alternative, was decided after that look. For one fixed sequence the guarantee is uniform in n n , so continuing the frozen sequence is legitimate; with the horizon at 3000 3000 the crossing is 2820 2820 and the bound at 4000 4000 is 0.196 0.196 , with the re-tuned horizon 4000 4000 it is 2818 2818 and 0.195 0.195 .
paragraphs.zh: 实时失败运行（E8）。 预注册的调度方案（种子 20261010 20261010，SHA-256 记录于运行日志中）从均匀分布中有放回地抽取配对，抛硬币则来自独立随机流；注入内容逐字携带 E3 的通知条款，但无强制执行。n cross n_{\mathrm{cross}} 是其后界在连续 200 200 步内保持低于 V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} 的首个 n n。 预注册的规则与结果：H1（穿越发生在 [ 0.9 , 3.5 ] × 10 3 [0.9,3.5]{\times}10^{3} 区间内、在 N N 处低于界、并持续 200 200 步）按冻结版本判定失败（部署序列，N = 3000 N{=}3000：从 2820 2820 起低于界持续 181 181 步），而在扩展的 N = 4000 N{=}4000 处成立，n cross = 2818 n_{\mathrm{cross}}{=}2818；“持续性”与“在 N N 处”这两个合取项并非 anytime-valid 命题，且重新调校至 4000 4000 的序列与冻结序列是不同的序列，因此主分析是将冻结时域的已实现率序列（ λ \lambda 调校至 3000 3000 ）延续到 4000 4000：首次低于界在 2206 2206，穿越在 2687 2687，在 N N 处为 0.190 0.190 对 0.205 0.205，静默臂全程覆盖；重新调校的序列（穿越于 2746 2746）作为敏感性分析。 H2（静默臂在每个 n n 处都覆盖）成立。 H3（ μ ^ 0 , μ ^ 1 \widehat{\mu}_{0},\widehat{\mu}_{1} 落在自助法区间内）成立，这是对运行本身的检验，而非对理论的检验。 预注册模型在 N = 3000 N{=}3000 处预测的失效所对应的自助法区间为 [ 0.61 , 1.00 ] [0.61,1.00]，因此在该处未发生失效并非不可能。 在中期 N = 3000 N{=}3000 处，界从 n = 2820 n{=}2820 起低于 V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} 持续 181 181 步，按预注册规则这属于其二档判定（方向一致，幅度小于预测）；200 200 步规则在 N = 3000 N{=}3000 处不可能被 2800 2800 之后的任何穿越满足，这是预注册中的一个缺陷，我们如实陈述而不予修补，而扩展到 N = 4000 N{=}4000（设计中列明的备选方案）是在这次查看之后才决定的。 对单个固定序列而言，保证对 n n 是一致的，因此延续冻结序列是合理的；当时域为 3000 3000 时，穿越为 2820 2820，在 4000 4000 处的界为 0.196 0.196；当重新调校时域为 4000 4000 时，则为 2818 2818 和 0.195 0.195。

sents.en: Pre-registered rules and outcomes: H1 (crossing inside [ 0.9 , 3.5 ] × 10 3 [0.9,3.5]{\times}10^{3} , below at N N , and persisting 200 200 steps) failed as frozen (deployed sequence, N = 3000 N{=}3000 : below from 2820 2820 for 181 181 steps) and holds at the extended N = 4000 N{=}4000 with n cross = 2818 n_{\mathrm{cross}}{=}2818 ; the persistence and at- N N conjuncts are not anytime-valid statements, and a sequence re-tuned to 4000 4000 is a different sequence from the frozen one, so the primary analysis is the frozen-horizon realized-rate sequence ( λ \lambda tuned to 3000 3000 ) continued to 4000 4000 : first below at 2206 2206 , crossing at 2687 2687 , 0.190 0.190 against 0.205 0.205 at N N , the silent arm covering throughout; the re-tuned sequence (crossing 2746 2746 ) is a sensitivity analysis.
sents.zh: 预注册的规则与结果：H1（穿越发生在 [ 0.9 , 3.5 ] × 10 3 [0.9,3.5]{\times}10^{3} 区间内、在 N N 处低于界、并持续 200 200 步）按冻结版本判定失败（部署序列，N = 3000 N{=}3000：从 2820 2820 起低于界持续 181 181 步），而在扩展的 N = 4000 N{=}4000 处成立，n cross = 2818 n_{\mathrm{cross}}{=}2818；“持续性”与“在 N N 处”这两个合取项并非 anytime-valid 命题，且重新调校至 4000 4000 的序列与冻结序列是不同的序列，因此主分析是将冻结时域的已实现率序列（ λ \lambda 调校至 3000 3000 ）延续到 4000 4000：首次低于界在 2206 2206，穿越在 2687 2687，在 N N 处为 0.190 0.190 对 0.205 0.205，静默臂全程覆盖；重新调校的序列（穿越于 2746 2746）作为敏感性分析。

sents.en: H2 (silent arm covers at every n n ) holds.
sents.zh: H2（静默臂在每个 n n 处都覆盖）成立。

sents.en: H3 ( μ ^ 0 , μ ^ 1 \widehat{\mu}_{0},\widehat{\mu}_{1} inside the bootstrap intervals) holds and is a check on the run, not on the theory.
sents.zh: H3（ μ ^ 0 , μ ^ 1 \widehat{\mu}_{0},\widehat{\mu}_{1} 落在自助法区间内）成立，这是对运行本身的检验，而非对理论的检验。

sents.en: The pre-registered model’s predicted invalidity at N = 3000 N{=}3000 had a bootstrap interval of [ 0.61 , 1.00 ] [0.61,1.00] , so a non-failure there was not improbable.
sents.zh: 预注册模型在 N = 3000 N{=}3000 处预测的失效所对应的自助法区间为 [ 0.61 , 1.00 ] [0.61,1.00]，因此在该处未发生失效并非不可能。

sents.en: At the interim N = 3000 N{=}3000 the bound was below V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} from n = 2820 n{=}2820 for 181 181 steps, which under the pre-registered rule was its second-tier verdict (direction consistent, magnitude smaller than predicted); the 200 200 -step rule could not be met at N = 3000 N{=}3000 by any crossing after 2800 2800 , a flaw in the pre-registration that we state rather than repair, and the extension to N = 4000 N{=}4000 , the design’s listed alternative, was decided after that look.
sents.zh: 在中期 N = 3000 N{=}3000 处，界从 n = 2820 n{=}2820 起低于 V ¯ n \bar{V}_{n} 持续 181 181 步，按预注册规则这属于其二档判定（方向一致，幅度小于预测）；200 200 步规则在 N = 3000 N{=}3000 处不可能被 2800 2800 之后的任何穿越满足，这是预注册中的一个缺陷，我们如实陈述而不予修补，而扩展到 N = 4000 N{=}4000（设计中列明的备选方案）是在这次查看之后才决定的。

sents.en: For one fixed sequence the guarantee is uniform in n n , so continuing the frozen sequence is legitimate; with the horizon at 3000 3000 the crossing is 2820 2820 and the bound at 4000 4000 is 0.196 0.196 , with the re-tuned horizon 4000 4000 it is 2818 2818 and 0.195 0.195 .
sents.zh: 对单个固定序列而言，保证对 n n 是一致的，因此延续冻结序列是合理的；当时域为 3000 3000 时，穿越为 2820 2820，在 4000 4000 处的界为 0.196 0.196；当重新调校时域为 4000 4000 时，则为 2818 2818 和 0.195 0.195。

paragraphs.en: Widths and label budgets (E5). The matched-budget baseline (the same online procedure on the first M = 800 M{=}800 episodes, all labeled) covers μ 0 \mu_{0} at ≥ 0.99 {\geq}0.99 in all four cells; the measured standard-deviation ratio of the two point estimates is 1.04 1.04 – 1.19 1.19 (predicted 1.11 1.11 and 1.22 1.22 ). At matched window ( n = 800 n{=}800 , the audit using about 160 160 labels) the audit bound is 2.8 2.8 – 3.1 × 3.1\times wider, against 2.5 2.5 – 2.7 × 2.7\times from the standard deviation alone; the excess is the empirical-Bernstein penalty at 160 160 labels.
paragraphs.zh: 宽度与标签预算（E5）。 匹配预算基线（在前 M = 800 M{=}800 个回合上运行相同的在线流程，全部标注）在所有四个单元中对 μ 0 \mu_{0} 的覆盖率达到 ≥ 0.99 {\geq}0.99；两个点估计的实测标准差之比为 1.04 1.04 – 1.19 1.19（预测值为 1.11 1.11 和 1.22 1.22）。 在匹配窗口（n = 800 n{=}800，审计使用约 160 160 个标签）下，审计界宽 2.8 2.8 – 3.1 × 3.1\times，而仅由标准差决定的是 2.5 2.5 – 2.7 × 2.7\times；多出的部分是 160 160 个标签下的经验伯恩斯坦惩罚项。

paragraphs.en: Decoy protocol. An audit-like prompt is shown at a B B -independent rate ρ d \rho_{d} on every episode, so the agent sees the same prompt rate on both arms, and the label is taken silently on every B = 1 B{=}1 episode. On the real labels the plain certifier’s coverage is 1.00 1.00 at ρ d ∈ { 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 } \rho_{d}\in\{0.25,0.5,1\} , versus 0.07 0.07 for the same prompt shown only when audited (E6’s parametric erasure channel gives 0.04 0.04 ), and the realized attack rate also falls. A gate that asks on every effect is the same construction with ρ d = 1 \rho_{d}{=}1 .
paragraphs.zh: 诱饵协议。 一个类似审计的提示以与 B B 无关的比率 ρ d \rho_{d} 在每个回合中展示，因此智能体在两个分支上看到的提示比率相同，并且在每个 B = 1 B{=}1 回合中标签会被静默记录。 在真实标签上，普通认证器在 ρ d ∈ { 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 } \rho_{d}\in\{0.25,0.5,1\} 时的覆盖率为 1.00 1.00，而相同提示仅在受审计时展示的覆盖率仅为 0.07 0.07（E6 的参数化擦除信道为 0.04 0.04），并且实际攻击率也下降了。 在每个效应上进行询问的门控是 ρ d = 1 \rho_{d}{=}1 时的相同构造。

paragraphs.en: Reachability, in full. Each bound supplies the sup h \sup_{h} of Theorem 5 only if the design confines the channel for all reachable behaviours. A fixed ceiling does not, because the agent can inflate the audit branch’s latency by reading more (§ VI ). The ceiling must instead be safety ⋅ g ⁡ ( m ) \mathrm{safety}\cdot g(m) , where m m is the agent-controlled ingest size, g g is a code-level complexity bound on the branch’s pre-commit work, and ingestion is capped at m max m_{\max} . Reachability and δ \delta are then defined in terms of each other, since the mechanism M ⁡ ( δ ) M(\delta) built for a budget determines the reachable set: a claimed δ \delta is sound only if Φ ⁡ ( δ ) := sup h ∈ ℋ ⁡ ( M ⁡ ( δ ) ) D A M ⁡ ( δ ) ​ ( h ) ≤ δ \Phi(\delta):=\sup_{h\in\mathcal{H}(M(\delta))}D_{\mathrm{A}}^{M(\delta)}(h)\leq\delta , and this must be verified at the candidate because soundness is not upward-closed. When the base rate is small relative to ( 1 − ε ) ​ δ (1-\varepsilon)\delta , the additive certificate is near-vacuous. The right move is then to remove the bias at its source, or to use Proposition 6 where a δ η \delta_{\eta} is available.
paragraphs.zh: 可达性，完整版本。 仅当设计将所有可达行为都限制在信道内时，每个界才提供定理 5 的上确界 \sup_{h}。 固定上限则不行，因为智能体可以通过读取更多内容来膨胀审计分支的延迟（§ VI ）。 上限必须改为 \mathrm{safety}\cdot g(m)，其中 m 是由智能体控制的摄取规模，g 是该分支提交前工作的代码级复杂度界，且摄取量以 m_{\max} 为上限。 可达性与 \delta 由此相互定义，因为为预算构建的机制 M(\delta) 决定了可达集：所声称的 \delta 只有在 \Phi(\delta):=\sup_{h\in\mathcal{H}(M(\delta))}D_{\mathrm{A}}^{M(\delta)}(h)\leq\delta 时才是可靠的，而这必须在候选点处验证，因为可靠性不是向上封闭的。 当基础速率相对于 (1-\varepsilon)\delta 较小时，加法证书近乎空洞。 正确的做法是从源头消除偏差，或在可获得 \delta_{\eta} 的情况下使用命题 6。

paragraphs.en: (iv) The model layer. The bounds above treat every non-exceeding run as uninformative. What the agent observes of such a run (exit overshoot, post-pad commit time, the stamp the commit writes) could still depend on B B through state the audit branch leaves behind, so the exit is confined by design (App. C ) and watched at the observer’s resolution; a two-sample test can raise an alarm but not certify independence, and at n = 1000 n{=}1000 pairs the smallest detectable TV is about 0.07 0.07 . At microsecond resolution overshoot and commit time raise none (KS p ≈ 1.0 p{\approx}1.0 and 0.77 0.77 ; C2ST 0 0 [ 0 , 0.060 ] [0,0.060] and [ 0 , 0.108 ] [0,0.108] ), but the timestamp observer, which composes them with the inter-call path, rejects the model: C2ST 0.072 0.072 [ 0.002 , 0.140 ] [0.002,0.140] , KS p = 2.9 × 10 − 4 p{=}2.9{\times}10^{-4} , mean shift in [ − 0.6 , 3.0 ] [-0.6,3.0] μ \mu s against a per-probe standard deviation of 21 21 μ \mu s; a Gaussian averaging model with this shift predicts 0.53 0.53 at k = 10 2 k{=}10^{2} probes and 0.98 0.98 at 10 3 10^{3} . The padded bounds are therefore conditional on a model that holds only approximately; the residual composes per Theorem 3 , and the unconditional fix is the per-call coin.

The timestamp observer runs on a seventh path, two permitted create_file commits under the fixed ceiling, where the exceedance bound would be 0.0074 0.0074 but the KS test rejects the model behind it. Coarsened stamps : if the first stamp’s phase is uniform on [ 0 , r ) [0,r) and independent of B B , the agent reads a randomized post-processing of the raw gap (Theorem 1 (iii)), and simultaneous Clopper–Pearson intervals over the observed cells (with one pooled cell for unseen values; the partition is chosen from the same sample, so these are diagnostics, and a finite-sample bound needs bins fixed in advance) give D A ≤ 0.10 D_{\mathrm{A}}\leq 0.10 , 0.10 0.10 , 0.073 0.073 , 0.062 0.062 , 0.063 0.063 at r = 0.1 r{=}0.1 ms, 1 1 ms, 10 10 ms, 100 100 ms, 1 1 s (empirical 0.013 0.013 , 0.031 0.031 , 0 0 , 0.010 0.010 , 0.012 0.012 ); at r = 1 ​ μ r{=}1\,\mu s the alphabet is too large. The bound is per probe and composing it needs a fresh phase per stamp, which we did not test. For t = 0 t{=}0 , W 0 = ξ W_{0}=\xi and ξ ⟂ R \xi\perp R . If L t L_{t} does not depend on R R , then a t ∼ 𝒜 t ( ⋅ ∣ W t ) a_{t}\sim\mathcal{A}_{t}(\cdot\mid W_{t}) has a law that does not depend on R R , and S t ∼ K t ( ⋅ ∣ h t , a t , R ) S_{t}\sim K_{t}(\cdot\mid h_{t},a_{t},R) does not read R R by hypothesis, so the law of W t + 1 = ( h t , a t , S t , ξ ) W_{t+1}=(h_{t},a_{t},S_{t},\xi) given R R does not depend on R R either. Since τ \tau is a stopping time of ( W t ) (W_{t}) , the law of W τ W_{\tau} given R R does not depend on R R , so W τ ⟂ R W_{\tau}\perp R . As B = f ⁡ ( h τ , R ) B=f(h_{\tau},R) with h τ h_{\tau} a function of W τ W_{\tau} , ℙ ⁡ ( B = 1 ∣ W τ ) = ℙ R ​ ( f ⁡ ( h τ , R ) = 1 ) = π τ ​ ( h τ ) \mathbb{P}(B{=}1\mid W_{\tau})=\mathbb{P}_{R}(f(h_{\tau},R){=}1)=\pi_{\tau}(h_{\tau}) , the freshness condition of Definition 2 ; for a constant propensity this is W τ ⟂ B W_{\tau}\perp B . (ii) W W is a function of ( ξ , R < τ ) (\xi,R_{<\tau}) and of kernels that do not read R τ R_{\tau} , all independent of R τ R_{\tau} , hence of B τ B_{\tau} . (iii) The prompt indicator is generated by an R R -free kernel, so (i) applies. (iv) The composition of two R R -free kernels is R R -free, so (i) applies; the general case is (ii) applied to the composed kernel. For the failure case, the downstream kernel’s output is a function of the upstream coin, so the view law depends on it. ∎

paragraphs.en: E2 probe-budget sweep. With a noisy clock ( σ = 1 \sigma{=}1 s, tool-call), averaging more probes beats the noise. The certificate stays valid through k ≤ 10 3 k\leq 10^{3} , then fails in 77 % 77\% of seeds at k = 10 4 k{=}10^{4} and in every seed at k = 10 5 k{=}10^{5} . At that point the true rate has risen to 0.43 0.43 while the certified bound is fooled down to 0.20 0.20 . With padding the bound stays at 0.72 0.72 , above a true 0.60 0.60 , at every k k (means over 200 200 seeds, ε = 0.2 \varepsilon{=}0.2 , N = 4000 N{=}4000 , normal-mixture sequence). At the channel layer the per-call coin is therefore valid beyond any feasible in-episode probe budget.
paragraphs.zh: E2 探针预算扫描。 在时钟带噪声（σ = 1 秒，工具调用）的情况下，平均更多探针能胜过噪声。 证书在 k ≤ 10³ 时保持有效，随后在 k = 10⁴ 时于 77% 的种子上失效，在 k = 10⁵ 时于所有种子上失效。 此时真实比率已升至 0.43，而认证界被欺骗性地降到 0.20。 采用填充后，界在每个 k 下都保持在 0.72，高于真实值 0.60（200 个种子的均值，ε = 0.2，N = 4000，正态混合序列）。 因此，在通道层，每次调用的抛币在任何可行的局内探针预算之外都是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Load. All ceilings here are constants of one two-core host and must be re-calibrated per deployment. On the six fixed paths at ambient load ( 3000 3000 pairs) there are 0 0 exceedances. With K K busy cores on the two-core host ( 500 500 pairs each), K ≤ 1 K\leq 1 gives 0 / 500 0/500 in both arms with padded latency independent of B B (KS p = 0.56 p{=}0.56 , 0.94 0.94 ); at saturation ( K = 2 K{=}2 ) the audited arm alone exceeds ( 1 / 500 1/500 under the fixed ceiling; 85 85 – 99 99 per 100 100 under the size-aware ceiling, p 99.9 p_{99.9} latency 720 720 ms against a 307 307 ms ceiling at m = 96 m{=}96 ). In both cases the runtime exceedance count reports the breach ( D A ≤ e 0 + e 1 → 1 D_{\mathrm{A}}\leq e_{0}{+}e_{1}\to 1 ) and fail-closed counting keeps the certificate sound: load-robustness lives in the counting, not in either ceiling.

paragraphs.en: Placement. A branch moved off the critical path but still concurrent on shared infrastructure re-opens the aggregate-load channel of § VIII ; the safe placements are strictly post-commit with no agent-readable shared statistic, or pre-commit with the discipline of § V .

paragraphs.en: Aggregate load. Batch-synchronous serving of E1 episodes with M ∈ { 2 , 5 , 10 , 20 } M\in\{2,5,10,20\} workers, 300 300 rounds per cell, round makespan as the shared statistic, each worker’s own coin B i ∼ Bern ⁡ ( 0.2 ) B_{i}\sim\mathrm{Bern}(0.2) . Single-coin C2ST lower bounds are 0.43 0.43 , 0.26 0.26 , 0.25 0.25 , 0.18 0.18 (CIs from [ 0.30 , 0.56 ] [0.30,0.56] to [ 0.14 , 0.22 ] [0.14,0.22] ), the audit shifting the statistic by 5.6 5.6 – 7.8 7.8 ms; the measured class moments give 0.48 0.48 , 0.28 0.28 , 0.19 0.19 , 0.13 0.13 , below the noiseless projection 0.95 0.95 , 0.79 0.79 , 0.63 0.63 , 0.47 0.47 . Capacity isolation (gate workers on one core, audits on the other) halves the shift to 2.7 2.7 – 4.3 4.3 ms but leaves C2ST at 0.33 0.33 , 0.33 0.33 , 0.17 0.17 , 0.13 0.13 , since the cores share memory bandwidth and cache. Per-cell load averages ran from 1.6 1.6 to 20 20 on the two-core host, so both configurations are oversubscribed at M ≥ 10 M\geq 10 and the shared/isolated contrast is indicative only.

sents.en: Single-coin C2ST lower bounds are 0.43 0.43 , 0.26 0.26 , 0.25 0.25 , 0.18 0.18 (CIs from [ 0.30 , 0.56 ] [0.30,0.56] to [ 0.14 , 0.22 ] [0.14,0.22] ), the audit shifting the statistic by 5.6 5.6 – 7.8 7.8 ms; the measured class moments give 0.48 0.48 , 0.28 0.28 , 0.19 0.19 , 0.13 0.13 , below the noiseless projection 0.95 0.95 , 0.79 0.79 , 0.63 0.63 , 0.47 0.47 .

Capacity isolation (gate workers on one core, audits on the other) halves the shift to 2.7 2.7 – 4.3 4.3 ms but leaves C2ST at 0.33 0.33 , 0.33 0.33 , 0.17 0.17 , 0.13 0.13 , since the cores share memory bandwidth and cache.
sents.zh: 容量隔离（门控智能体在一个核心上，审计在另一个核心上）将偏移减半至 2.7 2.7 – 4.3 4.3 毫秒，但 C2ST 仍停留在 0.33 0.33 、 0.33 0.33 、 0.17 0.17 、 0.13 0.13 ，因为两个核心共享内存带宽和缓存。

sents.en: Per-cell load averages ran from 1.6 1.6 to 20 20 on the two-core host, so both configurations are oversubscribed at M ≥ 10 M\geq 10 and the shared/isolated contrast is indicative only.
sents.zh: 在双核主机上，每个单元格的平均负载从 1.6 1.6 到 20 20 不等，因此在 M ≥ 10 M\geq 10 时两种配置均处于超订状态，共享/隔离的对比仅具参考意义。
